contract.scope: Fool, Death and Judgement automatic milestone effects, not optional social actions
contract.dateSemantics: MM-DD school-year cycle April through following January; no real-year assumption
contract.confirmation: Only trusted completed-story/boss/entry observations can set the corresponding flags. Passing a date is insufficient. Flag IDs are semantic adapter keys, not extracted game flag addresses.
contract.slotSemantics: Effects consume zero additional optional slots. Underlying story/expedition scheduling determines occupied slots; zero marginal cost never grants an extra free slot. Multiple ordered Judgement milestones can occur in one expedition.
contract.arbitraryCurrentState: Use observed current rank; do not reconstruct missing history from date or highest floor. Conflicting prior rank requires reconciliation. Explicit current-rank observation may initialize state independently.
contract.skipSemantics: Fool7→9 and Death1→3,3→5,6→8,8→10 are single milestones. Never synthesize the skipped intermediate ranks as separate actions.
